_: Every standing rule of derekzhou.com as data. Each rule: id (kebab-case, unique), area, rule (what holds), source (the owner's words and date where known, the record it is kept in), enforced_by (kind ci-step: a step name in .github/workflows/*.yml; world-rule: a rule id world_rules.py fails under; absence: a numbered (N) block of the step 'Absences are enforced'; hook: a .claude/hooks file that cites the rule's id; prose: written down only, checked by people). CI ('The rules are data, and the hooks hold', rules_check.py) proves every reference exists.

rules.rule: Nothing on the page darkens the world or lifts it for the words: no lift, floor, gain, veil, cap or calm about them. The composite takes no words input, so the frame with the words' machinery on and off is the same program on the same inputs (W7).

rules.rule: The words are always light, one set of colours on every sky and at every moment (text #fdfcf7, dimmed #ebeffa, ring #f4e2b0, selection #3b3f55), the same in style.css and the world. The world draws only skies they read on, under the light ceiling (OKLab L 0.53); no sky with dark words is kept, no ink is read from the ground or flips.

rules.rule: No fade-ins or fade-outs anywhere: no keyframes and no transitions in the stylesheet; the world's show is a cut, its frame drawn whole first; a sun or moon never fades where it stands; no bird fades in time (it shows by crossing the window's edge or out of the distance).

rules.rule: Left alone the view holds its heading; nothing turns it by itself. Only a drag (or, on iOS once asked, the phone's turn) steers. A pointer's moves are read only while it is pressed; no hover, no key.

rules.rule: The world's one crypto.getRandomValues, above its INIT-END marker, is the page's one entropy read; its one clock is clockNow() (performance.now), read for budgets only. The kits, wing model, ink birds, plan's worker and start file draw no entropy and read no clock; hour.js reads the clock once (new Date). No Math.random, no Date in the world.
Only the sky a visit opens on depends on the visitor's clock (hour.js); after that the order of skies is the world's own, random, with no clock.

source.quote: Only the starting landing scene should depend on the system time. The rest should cycle through smoothly randomly non-time-dependent.
source.doc: CLAUDE.md: Design; World: THE TIME OF DAY

rules.rule: The HTML has none of the internet's body language: no arrows, cookie or analytics vocabulary, Loading states or navigation roles.

No exit, idle, hover-position, key, blur, title, favicon-swap or storage handler in the JS; a pointer's moves are read only by the world's drag (its one pointermove listener added in onDown, removed in endDrag).
No innerHTML and no JS-generated DOM: the canvas, the stack, the footer and the lettered name are all in index.html.

No URL hook (location., URLSearchParams), sound, network call or eval; no worker but the plan's and the start file's table, each started by its literal name; no cursor: rule (OS cursors only). The site's own code is blind: no telemetry, beacon or store (Cloudflare Web Analytics, injected by Cloudflare, is the one exception).
The shipped scripts carry no development harness: no window.__*, window.claude or console call, and no attribute read on <html> but the hour's data-sky and data-sky-at.

CSP is set per HTML path with no overlapping rules (Cloudflare Pages combines same-named headers, and browsers enforce the intersection); never a Content-Security-Policy on /*. 404.html carries the same policy in a meta tag, kept in sync. Every home-scope CSP has exactly script-src 'self' https://static.cloudflareinsights.com and connect-src https://cloudflareinsights.com https://derekzhou.com/cdn-cgi/rum. No inline style, script or handler on a CSP'd page.

enforced_by.name: No inline code on CSP'd pages

rules.rule: The scripts load in their order (hour, start file, site.js, the world, the kits, the wing model, the ink birds), each tagged data-cfasync="false" for Rocket Loader; the start file is the one async script.

enforced_by.name: The world's page loads in order

rules.rule: Nothing but the site is served: site/ holds only the kinds of file the site serves, the root only the repository's own; CLAUDE.md, .github/ and the font scripts stay outside the build.
Nothing built is committed: a change is made in src/ and committed alone, and the build (tools/build.mjs) makes the rest, the same bytes every time.

enforced_by.name: The build, the same bytes every time; site/ holds no built file

rules.rule: Everything but HTML is cached immutable, so changed bytes need a new name: the build names scripts and the stylesheet by content; fonts and images are renamed by hand, with every reference, in the same commit.

enforced_by.name: The build, the same bytes every time; site/ holds no built file

rules.rule: Every visit of a device compiles the same shader sources, and a change to a program's text comes with its manifest and golden texts in the same commit (a returning visitor's shader cache depends on it).

enforced_by.name: Every visit compiles the same shaders
The shaders are their golden texts, and compile

rules.rule: Only code and assets under MIT, BSD, Apache, ISC, zlib, Unlicense or CC0 go into the site, plus CC BY for research data with credit given. Fonts must be licensed for the web (open-licensed like Geist's OFL, or a bought web licence); never unlicensed copies or a desktop font file.

Never name, in the repository, a commit or a PR: the reference game, its studio, a painter or any person (beyond the owner as the site's subject); never the removed side project. Banned names are kept as salted hashes in .claude/hooks/names.json, never written out.

source.doc: CLAUDE.md: Design ("at the owner's word its name stays out of the repo, its commits and its PRs")

rules.rule: Changes reach main only through a pull request, merged by the owner, or by the merge bot when nothing visible changes. An agent never merges and never pushes to main.

enforced_by.name: Merge, or leave it for the owner

rules.rule: Never force-push and never delete a remote branch.

rules.rule: Pure HTML, CSS and JS, no frameworks; no Unreal or streamed engine: the world is drawn in the page itself, in WebGL2, generated in code (no picture, no model file).

rules.rule: Trusted Types stays off while Cloudflare Rocket Loader is on (it re-executes scripts through a TT sink); if Rocket Loader is ever disabled, re-add require-trusted-types-for 'script' to the three home-scope CSP blocks.
